main_body: Steampunk factory building: a large corrugated metal roof slope with a raised centre clerestory and a chimney, over a brick wall with arched windows, brass pipes and a riveted double door
top_band: Roof slope read down x=80: a light ridge line at row 49 (L158), then a mid-grey corrugated slope with the dark clerestory band at rows 53-58 and a lighter band at rows 59-63. The slope continues in mid grey to row 90, closed by an orange eave line at row 92.
evidence: The roof is a large slanted surface (rows 49-91) with a ridge line, a raised clerestory and slightly trapezoidal sides. It is separated from the brick wall (rows 93-135) by an orange eave line at row 92 and a dark row at 94. The wall shows its own front face. The windows are arched with inset dark frames, and the door has a dark inner border. The roof slope plus the front wall reads like the house references, so this is a valid 3/4 building with no receding side faces.

style.evidence: The measured facts are well below both references. The candidate has 37 distinct colours against 185 and 66, and 9 colours per tile against 18 and 11. 89% of its dark edge pixels are neutral (the references are 7-9%), so the outline is a near-black line (#14181f, #1f2630) rather than a dark tone of the adjacent material. Flat-fill coverage is only 1%, because the roof corrugation and rust dots add some texture. The roof and wall ramps are grey and brick with about 5 steps, but they are thinner and more sticker-like than the references' tinted shading, so the piece does not match their standard.
